'I will always be able to find work.' Chef Barinov puts the word for 'always' together with 'will be able to' and 'to find' in a crisp, natural spoken turn of phrase.

'Your daughter studies in Paris.' Here Nagiyev anchors the line on the word meaning 'daughter' and builds the thought around 'to study'.

'This costs twenty thousand a year.' Nagiyev chooses the imperfective verb meaning 'is parked' for the ongoing action, followed by 'twenty' and 'thousand'.

'I know my debts.' Chef Barinov chooses the imperfective verb meaning 'know' for the ongoing action, followed by 'debt'.

'No one will tolerate your character.' Nagiyev chooses the imperfective verb meaning 'will be' for the ongoing action, followed by 'to hold on' and 'character'.
